settings.content: Everything worth knowing before you choose a diamond

settings.heading: Diamonds Explained Without the Jargon
settings.body:
Diamond is the classic choice for engagement rings and many wedding bands because it combines brilliance, durability and symbolism. It is hard, bright, versatile, and suited to everyday jewellery when set well.

But diamond is not one single look. A round brilliant feels crisp and bright. An emerald cut feels elegant and architectural. An old mine cut feels romantic and antique. A salt-and-pepper diamond feels earthy and distinctive. A yellow diamond feels warm and joyful. A lab-grown diamond can offer impressive size and specification within a more accessible budget.

The single most useful thing to understand is that diamonds should not be judged by carat weight alone. Two diamonds of the same carat can look entirely different in size, sparkle, colour and beauty. Cut, proportions and shape often matter more than the number printed on the report.

settings.heading: Natural White Diamonds
settings.body: Traditional, rare and geologically formed. The classic route when rarity and tradition matter most, with an established secondary market. Browse natural diamonds.

settings.heading: Lab-Grown Diamonds
settings.body: Real diamonds grown in a controlled environment, chemically and optically identical to mined stones. Often considerably more size for the budget. Browse lab-grown.

settings.heading: Fancy Coloured Diamonds
settings.body: Diamonds with noticeable colour: yellow, champagne, cognac, pink, blue, green or black. All share diamond's hardness. Browse coloured diamonds.

settings.heading: Character Diamonds
settings.body: Salt-and-pepper, included, antique-cut or unusual diamonds chosen for individuality rather than grading. Every one is unique. Browse salt and pepper.

settings.heading: The Main Diamond Choices
settings.intro: None is more correct than the others. Which one suits depends on whether you value rarity, size, colour or character most.

settings.heading: Guaranteed Conflict-Free
settings.body:
All natural diamonds supplied by For Your Eternity are guaranteed conflict-free, adhering strictly to the Kimberley Process certification scheme and to ethical supply-chain standards. We use recycled and responsibly sourced precious metals as our standard approach.

Every stone is sourced after you have told us cut, colour, clarity, carat, report and origin. Nothing is bought in bulk to clear, which means we can almost always find a better stone for your budget than a stock-led retailer.
